occurrences.text: And he said unto them, Render therefore unto Cesar the things which be Cesar’s, and unto God the things which be God’s.
I therefore so run, not as uncertainly; so fight I, not as one that beateth the air:
Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.
Ye see then how that by works a man is justified, and not by faith only.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
